g.text: Same frozen engines, prompts, 3 seeds and 16,384-token cap · common low reasoning · no reflection
Each axis averages eligible hole-type rates. Hints provide fresh, targeted attempts on each model’s own misses.
Complete blind grids: 4/5 models. Incomplete grids are omitted, not counted as zero. Engine activation is not verified discovery.
